items.title_cn: 超声内镜引导下胰腺疾病及术后解剖改变患者胰管引流的处理：叙述性综述
items.title_en: Endoscopic ultrasound-guided management of pancreatic duct drainage in patients with pancreatic disease and surgically altered anatomy: a narrative review
items.abstract_cn: 背景：胰空肠吻合口狭窄和胰管结石可能增加管内压力，导致解剖结构改变（尤其是胰十二指肠切除术后）的患者出现腹痛或复发性胰腺炎。球囊小肠镜辅助内镜逆行胰管造影是一种微创选择；然而，到达并识别吻合口以及实现选择性插管在技术上可能较为困难，导致相当高的失败率。摘要：超声内镜引导下胰管引流术（EUS-PDD）在此类病例中是一种有效的替代方案，近期研究报告了较高的技术成功率和持久的症状控制。然而，该操作的每一步，包括胰管穿刺、导丝操作、通道扩张和支架置入，均具有特定的技术挑战，且胰液漏、出血、胰腺炎和支架移位等不良事件仍具有临床意义。本叙述性综述聚焦于解剖结构改变患者的EUS-PDD，特别是因胰空肠吻合口狭窄和胰管结石导致复发性胰腺炎的患者。总结了患者选择、治疗流程、操作技术和实用技巧、问题处理以及短期和长期临床结局。我们还讨论了通过成熟的EUS创建通道治疗胰管结石的方法。关键信息：EUS-PDD不应仅被视为一种挽救性引流操作，而应被视为一个分期治疗平台，旨在实现吻合口再通、结石清除、预防复发性胰腺炎，并在可行时最终实现无支架管理。总体而言，仔细的病例选择、专用器械和多学科后备支持对于安全实施仍然至关重要。
items.abstract_en: Background: Pancreaticojejunostomy anastomotic strictures and pancreatic duct stones may increase intraductal pressure and cause abdominal pain or recurrent pancreatitis in patients with surgically altered anatomy, particularly after pancreaticoduodenectomy. Balloon enteroscopy-assisted endoscopic retrograde pancreatography is a minimally invasive option; however, reaching and identifying the anastomosis and achieving selective cannulation can be technically difficult, resulting in a substantial failure rate. Summary: Endoscopic ultrasound-guided pancreatic duct drainage (EUS-PDD) is an effective alternative in such cases, with recent studies reporting a high technical success rate and durable symptom control. Nevertheless, each step in this procedure, including pancreatic duct puncture, guidewire manipulation, tract dilation, and stent deployment, has specific technical challenges, and adverse events such as pancreatic juice leakage, bleeding, pancreatitis, and stent migration, remain clinically relevant. This narrative review focuses on EUS-PDD in patients with surgically altered anatomy, particularly those with recurrent pancreatitis caused by pancreaticojejunostomy stricture and pancreatic duct stones. Patient selection, treatment algorithms, procedural techniques and practical tips, troubleshooting, and short-term and long-term clinical outcomes are summarized. We also discuss treatment of pancreatic duct stones through a mature EUS-created tract. Key messages: EUS-PDD should be regarded not merely as a salvage drainage procedure but as a platform for staged therapy aimed at anastomotic recanalization, stone clearance, prevention of recurrent pancreatitis, and, when feasible, eventual stent-free management. Overall, careful case selection, dedicated devices, and multidisciplinary backup remain essential for safe implementation.
items.summary_cn: 该综述聚焦于外科解剖改变（尤其是胰十二指肠切除术后）患者中胰肠吻合口狭窄和胰管结石所致复发性胰腺炎的EUS引导下胰管引流（EUS-PDD），总结其患者选择、操作技术、并发症处理及长期结局，并提出EUS-PDD应被视为实现吻合口再通、结石清除和最终免支架管理的分期治疗平台，而非单纯的挽救性引流手段。

items.title_cn: 可解释机器学习用于感染性胰腺坏死开放手术清创或视频辅助腹膜后清创术后特定术式死亡率预测
items.title_en: Interpretable machine learning for procedure-specific mortality prediction after open surgical necrosectomy or video-assisted retroperitoneal debridement in infected pancreatic necrosis
items.abstract_cn: 目的 感染性胰腺坏死（IPN）具有较高的死亡率，接受开放手术坏死组织清除术（OSN）或视频辅助腹膜后清创术（VARD）的患者可能呈现不同的预后特征。鉴于手术治疗IPN的临床数据有限，本研究旨在开发可解释的、针对特定术式的死亡预测模型，并描述与每种手术策略相关的不同预后模式。方法 本回顾性研究分析了瑞金医院的143例患者，先按年龄和性别进行倾向性评分匹配，随后排除1例VARD患者，最终纳入2014—2018年期间接受OSN治疗的96例患者和2019—2024年期间接受VARD治疗的47例患者。结局指标为首次坏死组织清除术后90天内的全因死亡率。使用术前临床、实验室和影像学变量分别建立CatBoost模型。内部评估包括在固定CatBoost设置下重复进行特征选择，以及额外的10次重复嵌套交叉验证分析，其中超参数和特征选择均限定于每个外层训练集内。校准和条件自助法区间使用早期固定参数分析中存储的预测值进行评估。SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）用于描述全局和个体特征-预测关联。哈尔滨医科大学附属第一医院的独立队列用于初步外部评估。结果 在额外的嵌套分析中，OSN的中位折外AUROC为0.810，VARD为0.726，各重复间的范围分别为0.773~0.833和0.670~0.788。中位Brier评分分别为0.149和0.100。在选定的OSN模型中，血小板计数、体重指数和术前降钙素原具有突出的SHAP贡献；在选定的VARD模型中，术前降钙素原以及肾脏和呼吸状态较为突出。这些重点预测因子在重采样分析中被反复选中，支持对其术式特异性预后模式进行进一步研究。初步外部评估在66例OSN患者中得出AUROC为0.891，在10例VARD患者中为0.778。SHAP分析进一步揭示了不同的非线性、术式特异性预后特征，突出了两种手术策略相关的主导风险模式的差异。结论 可解释的术式特异性模型识别了OSN和VARD术后不同的预后模式。这些探索性发现为制定和前瞻性评估IPN个体化手术管理策略提供了基础。
items.abstract_en: Objective Infected pancreatic necrosis (IPN) carries substantial mortality, and patients undergoing open surgical necrosectomy (OSN) or video-assisted retroperitoneal debridement (VARD) may exhibit different prognostic profiles. Given the limited clinical data available for surgically treated IPN, this study aimed to develop interpretable, procedure-specific mortality prediction models and characterize distinct prognostic patterns associated with each surgical strategy. Methods This retrospective study analyzed 143 patients from Ruijin Hospital after propensity-score matching on age and sex and subsequent exclusion of one VARD patient, including 96 patients treated with OSN during 2014–2018 and 47 treated with VARD during 2019–2024. The outcome was all-cause mortality within 90 days after the first necrosectomy. Separate CatBoost models were developed using preoperative clinical, laboratory, and imaging variables. Internal evaluation included repeated feature selection under fixed CatBoost settings and an additional 10-repetition nested cross-validation analysis with hyperparameter and feature selection confined to each outer training set. Calibration and conditional bootstrap intervals were evaluated using stored predictions from the earlier fixed-parameter analysis. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) characterized global and individual feature-prediction associations. Independent cohorts from the First Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University were used for preliminary external evaluation. Results In the additional nested analysis, median out-of-fold AUROC was 0.810 for OSN and 0.726 for VARD, with ranges across repetitions of 0.773–0.833 and 0.670–0.788, respectively. Median Brier scores were 0.149 and 0.100. In the selected OSN model, platelet count, body mass index, and preoperative procalcitonin had prominent SHAP contributions; in the selected VARD model, preoperative procalcitonin and renal and respiratory status were prominent. These highlighted predictors were repeatedly selected in the resampling analyses, supporting further investigation of their procedure-specific prognostic patterns. Preliminary external evaluation yielded AUROCs of 0.891 in 66 OSN patients and 0.778 in 10 VARD patients. SHAP analysis further revealed distinct nonlinear, procedure-specific prognostic profiles, highlighting differences in the dominant risk patterns associated with the two surgical strategies. Conclusion Interpretable procedure-specific models identified heterogeneous prognostic patterns after OSN and VARD. These exploratory findings provide a basis for developing and prospectively evaluating individualized surgical management strategies in IPN.
items.summary_cn: 该研究针对感染性胰腺坏死患者，分别构建了开放手术坏死清除术（OSN）与视频辅助腹膜后清创术（VARD）的可解释机器学习90天死亡预测模型，嵌套交叉验证中OSN与VARD的中位AUROC分别为0.810和0.726，外部初步验证AUROC分别为0.891和0.778。SHAP分析显示两种术式具有不同的主导预后因素模式：OSN以血小板计数、BMI和术前降钙素原贡献突出，VARD以术前降钙素原及肾脏和呼吸状态贡献突出。

items.title_cn: 西格列汀通过改善肠道菌群和激活Nrf2信号通路减轻重症急性胰腺炎诱导的铁死亡
items.title_en: Sitagliptin mitigates ferroptosis induced by severe acute pancreatitis through gut microbiota improvement and activation of Nrf2 signaling pathway.
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题提示西格列汀可通过改善肠道菌群并激活Nrf2信号通路来减轻重症急性胰腺炎诱导的铁死亡，但摘要内容缺失，无法提供更具体的核心发现。

items.title_cn: ALKBH5介导的WWP1 mRNA m6A去甲基化通过稳定MAPK14驱动急性胰腺炎铁死亡
items.title_en: ALKBH5-mediated m6A demethylation of WWP1 mRNA drives ferroptosis in acute pancreatitis via MAPK14 stabilization.
items.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在探讨E3泛素连接酶含WW结构域的E3泛素蛋白连接酶1（WWP1）在急性胰腺炎（AP）中的调控机制。利用L-精氨酸（L-Arg）诱导的AP小鼠模型和原代小鼠胰腺腺泡细胞模型，结合GEO数据集分析，我们发现AP中WWP1表达显著下调，而WWP1过表达可减轻腺泡细胞损伤、抑制铁死亡并抑制炎症反应。机制研究表明，WWP1作为E3泛素连接酶，直接结合丝裂原活化蛋白激酶14（MAPK14）并促进其蛋白酶体降解；AP条件下WWP1下调导致MAPK14蛋白稳定性增加。进一步研究发现，m6A去甲基化酶AlkB同源蛋白5（ALKBH5）在AP中异常上调，并伴随其整体m6A修饰水平降低而加速WWP1 mRNA降解，从而在表观转录水平抑制WWP1表达。敲低ALKBH5可恢复WWP1表达，抑制MAPK14活化和铁死亡，而过表达MAPK14则逆转了这种保护作用。体内过表达WWP1可有效减轻AP小鼠的胰腺病理损伤。本研究首次阐明了ALKBH5-WWP1-MAPK14信号轴在AP中的核心作用：AP条件下ALKBH5上调通过m6A去甲基化抑制WWP1表达，解除其对MAPK14的泛素介导降解，导致MAPK14异常蓄积并驱动腺泡细胞铁死亡，从而为AP的靶向治疗提供了新策略。
items.abstract_en: This study aimed to investigate the regulatory mechanism of the E3 ubiquitin ligase WW domain containing E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1 (WWP1) in acute pancreatitis (AP). Using an L-arginine (L-Arg)-induced AP mouse model and primary mouse pancreatic acinar cell model, combined with GEO dataset analysis, we found that WWP1 expression was significantly downregulated in AP, while overexpression of WWP1 alleviated acinar cell injury, inhibited ferroptosis, and suppressed inflammatory responses. Mechanistic studies revealed that WWP1, as an E3 ubiquitin ligase, directly binds to mitogen-activated protein kinase 14 (MAPK14) and promotes its proteasomal degradation; downregulation of WWP1 under AP conditions led to increased stability of MAPK14 protein. Further investigation demonstrated that the m6A demethylase AlkB homolog 5 (ALKBH5) was aberrantly upregulated in AP and accelerated WWP1 mRNA degradation in association with the reduction of its overall m6A modification level, thereby suppressing WWP1 expression at the epitranscriptional level. Knockdown of ALKBH5 restored WWP1 expression, inhibited MAPK14 activation and ferroptosis, while overexpression of MAPK14 reversed this protective effect. In vivo overexpression of WWP1 effectively attenuated pancreatic pathological damage in AP mice. This study elucidates for the first time the core role of the ALKBH5-WWP1-MAPK14 signaling axis in AP: upregulation of ALKBH5 under AP conditions suppresses WWP1 expression via m6A demethylation, relieving its ubiquitin-mediated degradation of MAPK14, leading to aberrant accumulation of MAPK14 and driving acinar cell ferroptosis, thereby providing a new strategy for targeted therapy of AP.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现ALKBH5在急性胰腺炎中异常上调，通过m6A去甲基化加速WWP1 mRNA降解，导致WWP1下调、MAPK14蛋白稳定性增加，进而驱动腺泡细胞铁死亡和炎症反应；过表达WWP1可在体内减轻AP小鼠胰腺病理损伤，揭示了ALKBH5-WWP1-MAPK14轴作为AP靶向治疗的新策略。

items.title_cn: 继发于胰腺假性囊肿的左侧门静脉高压以贫血为首发表现：一例病例报告及文献复习
items.title_en: Left-sided portal hypertension secondary to pancreatic pseudocyst presenting with anaemia: A case report and literature review.
items.abstract_cn: 左侧门静脉高压（LSPH）是一种罕见的临床病症，最常与胰腺炎继发的脾静脉血栓形成相关。胃底静脉曲张可作为静脉引流受损的后果而发生，并可能导致危及生命的上消化道出血。我们报告一例继发于急性胰腺炎及随后胰腺假性囊肿形成的LSPH病例，导致脾静脉血栓形成、静脉曲张出血、贫血、血小板减少和脾功能亢进。患者经左肋下切口行脾切除术联合囊肿胃吻合术。LSPH相关症状完全缓解，患者于术后第5天出院。在9个月的随访中，增强计算机断层扫描显示胰腺假性囊肿和胃底静脉曲张完全消退。对于伴有贫血的胰腺假性囊肿患者，应仔细评估与脾静脉血栓形成相关的并发症。在选定的LSPH患者中，脾切除术联合囊肿胃吻合术可能是一种有效的治疗选择。
items.abstract_en: Left-sided portal hypertension (LSPH) is a rare clinical condition most commonly associated with splenic vein thrombosis secondary to pancreatitis. Gastric fundal varices may develop as a consequence of impaired venous drainage and can lead to life-threatening upper gastrointestinal bleeding. We present a case of LSPH secondary to acute pancreatitis and subsequent pancreatic pseudocyst formation, resulting in splenic vein thrombosis, variceal bleeding, anaemia, thrombocytopenia, and hypersplenism. The patient underwent splenectomy combined with cystogastrostomy through a left subcostal incision. LSPH-related symptoms resolved completely and the patient was discharged on postoperative Day 5. At the 9-month follow-up, contrast-enhanced computed tomography demonstrated complete resolution of the pancreatic pseudocyst and fundal varices. In patients with pancreatic pseudocysts accompanied by anaemia, complications related to splenic vein thrombosis should be carefully evaluated. In selected patients with LSPH, combined splenectomy and cystogastrostomy may be an effective therapeutic option.
items.journal: Anales del Sistema Sanitario de Navarra
items.summary_cn: 本文报道一例急性胰腺炎后胰腺假性囊肿继发脾静脉血栓形成导致左侧门静脉高压、胃底静脉曲张出血及贫血的病例，采用脾切除联合囊肿胃吻合术治疗后症状完全缓解，假性囊肿及胃底静脉曲张消失。提示对伴贫血的胰腺假性囊肿患者应评估脾静脉血栓相关并发症，特定患者中联合手术可能有效。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎生物标志物：当前证据与临床实用性：叙述性综述
items.title_en: Biomarkers in Acute Pancreatitis: Current Evidence and Clinical Utility: A Narrative Review
items.abstract_cn: 急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种胰腺炎症性疾病，其临床病程多变，从轻度自限性到严重危及生命的形式不等，常并发坏死和多器官功能衰竭。尽管近几十年来在诊断和治疗方面取得了显著进展，但疾病严重程度的早期准确评估仍是一项重大的临床挑战。生物标志物在AP的诊断、风险分层和监测中发挥着关键作用，并可指导合适治疗方案的选择，包括及时升级治疗。本综述结合生物标志物的应用，讨论了AP的病理生理学和疾病严重程度分类。文章描述了传统的预后工具，并表征了已确立和有前景的新型生物标志物，涵盖从常规检测的酶类（淀粉酶和脂肪酶）和炎症标志物（CRP和IL-6）到最新的分子、遗传和代谢组学标志物。本综述还展望了将生物标志物与人工智能工具整合用于精准医学和个性化医学发展的前景。
items.abstract_en: Acute pancreatitis (AP) is an inflammatory condition of the pancreas with a variable clinical course, ranging from mild and self-limiting to severe and life-threatening forms, often complicated by necrosis and multiple organ failure. Despite the advances in diagnosis and treatment that have been witnessed in recent decades, the early and accurate assessment of disease severity remains a significant clinical challenge. Biomarkers play a key role in the diagnosis, risk stratification, and monitoring of AP, and they may guide the selection of appropriate therapy, including timely treatment escalation. This review discusses the pathophysiology of AP and disease severity classification in the context of biomarker use. It describes conventional prognostic tools and characterizes both established and promising novel biomarkers, ranging from routinely measured enzymes (amylase and lipase) and inflammatory markers (CRP and IL-6) to the latest molecular, genetic, and metabolomic markers. The review also presents the prospects for integrating biomarkers with artificial intelligence tools in the development of precision and personalized medicine.
items.summary_cn: 该综述指出急性胰腺炎早期准确评估疾病严重程度仍是显著临床挑战，生物标志物在诊断、风险分层和监测中起关键作用，并可指导包括及时升级治疗在内的治疗选择。文章系统描述了从常规淀粉酶、脂肪酶、CRP、IL-6到分子、遗传和代谢组学等新型标志物，并展望了生物标志物与人工智能结合用于精准和个性化医学的前景。

items.title_cn: 基于机器学习的急性胰腺炎患者复发风险预测模型构建：单中心回顾性队列研究
items.title_en: Construction of machine‑learning‑based prediction models for recurrence risk in patients with acute pancreatitis: a single‑center retrospective cohort study
items.abstract_cn: 背景 急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种常见的急性胃肠道疾病，全球发病率呈上升趋势，是患者住院的常见原因[1‑3]。尽管许多患者在初次住院后康复，但相当一部分患者会发生复发性急性胰腺炎。反复发作的胰腺炎症会增加慢性胰腺并发症的风险，造成患者痛苦并加重医疗经济负担[4‑5]。
items.abstract_en: Background Acute pancreatitis (AP) is a common acute gastrointestinal disease with rising global incidence and represents a frequent cause for hospital admission[1‑3]. Although many patients recover after initial hospitalization, a notable subset will suffer recurrent acute pancreatitis. Repeated pancreatic inflammatory episodes increase the risk of chronic pancreatic complications, cause patient suffering and raise medical‑economic burdens[4‑5].
items.summary_cn: 该研究基于单中心回顾性队列构建机器学习模型，用于预测急性胰腺炎患者的复发风险；摘要指出尽管多数患者初次住院后可康复，但相当一部分患者会发生复发性急性胰腺炎，反复胰腺炎症发作会增加慢性胰腺并发症风险并加重患者痛苦与医疗经济负担。

items.title_cn: 内镜超声在胰腺导管腺癌和慢性胰腺炎中的应用：从诊断到干预
items.title_en: Endoscopic ultrasound in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and chronic pancreatitis: from diagnosis to intervention
items.abstract_cn: 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）仍然是最致命的恶性肿瘤之一，五年生存率仅为12%，而慢性胰腺炎（CP）则通过疼痛、胰管梗阻和外分泌功能不全带来显著的长期疾病负担。超声内镜（EUS）及其不断扩展的引导下介入手段已彻底改变了两者的诊断和治疗格局。本叙述性综述综合了以下方面的当代证据：（1）EUS引导下的组织获取、消融治疗（包括射频消融（RFA）和光动力疗法）以及PDAC中的瘤内注射策略；（2）胆管胰管镜在胆道狭窄诊断和胰管结石管理中的作用；（3）CP相关并发症的内镜治疗方法，包括胰管（PD）狭窄、管内结石、假性囊肿、胆道狭窄以及EUS引导下胰管引流（EUS-PDD）。在PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus和Web of Science中进行了聚焦文献检索，检索时间从数据库建库至2026年3月。本综述还探讨了基于EUS的CP评估、胰腺恶性肿瘤诊断失败的原因以及改善组织获取和临床决策的策略。将已确立的诊断和引流应用与尚在研究中的局部治疗加以区分。多学科整合和进一步的前瞻性验证对于明确新兴技术的临床价值仍然至关重要。
items.abstract_en: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains one of the most lethal malignancies, with a five-year survival rate of only 12%, while chronic pancreatitis (CP) imposes significant long-term morbidity through pain, ductal obstruction, and exocrine insufficiency. Endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) and its expanding armamentarium of guided interventions have transformed the diagnostic and therapeutic landscape for both conditions. This narrative review synthesizes contemporary evidence on (1) EUS-guided tissue acquisition, ablative therapies, including radiofrequency ablation (RFA) and photodynamic therapy, and intratumoral injection strategies in PDAC (2) the role of cholangiopancreatoscopy in biliary stricture diagnosis and ductal stone management; and (3) endoscopic approaches to CP-related complications, including pancreatic duct (PD) strictures, intraductal stones, pseudocysts, biliary strictures, and EUS-guided pancreatic duct drainage (EUS-PDD). A focused literature search was conducted in PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science from database inception to March 2026. The review also examines EUS-based assessment of CP, causes of diagnostic failure in pancreatic malignancy, and strategies to improve tissue acquisition and clinical decision-making. Established diagnostic and drainage applications are distinguished from investigational local therapies. Multidisciplinary integration and further prospective validation remain essential to define the clinical value of emerging techniques.
items.summary_cn: 该综述综合了EUS及其引导介入在胰腺导管腺癌和慢性胰腺炎中的应用证据，涵盖EUS引导组织获取、射频消融和光动力治疗等消融疗法及瘤内注射策略，胆胰管镜在胆道狭窄诊断和结石管理中的作用，以及慢性胰腺炎相关并发症（胰管狭窄、结石、假性囊肿、胆道狭窄和EUS引导胰管引流）的内镜处理。综述还区分了已确立的诊断与引流应用和处于研究阶段的局部治疗，并强调多学科整合与前瞻性验证的必要性。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
